page.title: Competitive radar
page.source: From data already scanned, no extra scans

promos.title: Competitor promotions
promos.info: Promotion labels on Booking.com and their depth versus the strikethrough price, grouped by label. “Booking.com-applied” is Genius, an app-only price or a coupon applied by Booking.com; “Hotel deal” is a deal the hotel turned on (Late Escape, Early Bird…).
promos.stripLabel: Share of competitors on promotion per night
promos.stripHint: The taller the bar, the more competitors run a promotion that night.

origin.channelTitle: Applied by Booking.com (Genius, app-only price, coupon code): guests see a lower price, but it is not a deal the hotel turned on
origin.hotelTitle: The hotel turned this promotion on itself on Booking.com (Early Bird, Last-minute, Late Escape…)

promos.emptyBody: No competitor ran a promotion on Booking.com in this period.

restrictions.title: Sales restrictions
restrictions.info: Nights a competitor still sells on Booking.com but with conditions: a minimum stay or no arrivals that day. This is not sold out.
restrictions.minStayTitle: Only sold for stays of {count}+ nights
restrictions.ctaTitle: Closed to arrival on this date
restrictions.emptyBody: No competitor set restrictions in this period.

cancellation.title: Cancellation policy
cancellation.info: For each priced night: is there a free-cancellation rate, and how much cheaper is the non-refundable rate than the flexible one with the same meal plan (median of same-night pairs). 10–20% is typical.
cancellation.emptyBody: No priced nights on Booking.com in this period.

scarcity.title: Area availability
scarcity.description: {area} · properties with availability on Booking at the latest scan
scarcity.info: Each night: how many hotels/properties in the area still have rooms according to Booking's search page at the latest scan, compared with the same night at a scan at least 7 days earlier. A fast drop = the area is filling up.
scarcity.noTightening: No night has dropped versus a week earlier yet (needs at least 7 days of scans).
scarcity.noAreaBody: Add an area (city or district) under Settings › Market to track how many properties are still available across the area.
scarcity.emptyBody: The area has no scans for these nights yet.
